entries.question: Jow tofix a cinsult to a cardiologist online
entries.answer:
To consult a cardiologist online at KGMU, you can book an online OPD appointment through the official Online Registration System (ORS):

1. Visit the ORS portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
2. Register or log in using your mobile number and OTP.
3. Select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and choose **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**.
4. Select the **Cardiology** (Lari Cardiology) department, choose an available date, and fill in the patient details.
5. Pay the nominal OPD slip fee of ₹50 online and download your appointment slip.

Alternatively, you can pre-book an appointment by sending an SMS with `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**. 

*Note: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Want to take online appointment for OPD
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment for the KGMU OPD, you can use one of the following methods:

- **Official Online Portal (ORS):** Visit the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the department, date, and time, enter your patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee to download your slip.
- **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection flow.
- **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` to **8887019134**.

**Important OPD Guidelines:**
- Online registration is mandatory.
- OPD timings are Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM); closed on Sundays.
- Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department.
- For patient support or inquiries, you can contact the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Mai try karta hu online booking nahi hota gai aisa kyo
entries.answer:
Online booking mein aane wali samasya ke kai karan ho sakte hain:

1. **Server ya Network Issue:** KGMU ki online booking portal ya National Health Portal (ORS) par traffic zyada hone ki wajah se server slow ho sakta hai. Kuch der baad dobara try karein.
2. **Details Mismatch:** Patient ka naam, age, mobile number ya OTP darj karte waqt koi galti hone par booking rukh sakti hai.
3. **Pehle se Registration:** Agar us mobile number ya ABHA ID se pehle hi us din ya limit ke andar appointment booked hai, toh naya appointment nahi banega.
4. **Quota Full:** Us din ke liye available slots khatam ho chuke ho sakte hain.

**Aap kya kar sakte hain:**
- Aap official website [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) ke zariye try kar sakte hain.
- **SMS ke zariye:** `Appointment [Patient Name]` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.
- **Walk-in (Offline):** Aap direct KGMU OPD jakar wahan counter par Aadhaar card aur active mobile number dekar ₹50 ki slip banwa sakte hain (Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje tak khula rehta hai).

Kisi bhi sahayata ke liye aap KGMU helpline number **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par sampark kar sakte hain.

entries.question: I have missed my uhid number slip how I can restore it?
entries.answer:
I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

If you have lost your UHID number slip at KGMU, you can easily retrieve or restore it through the following steps:

1. **Visit the Patient Registration or Help Desk:** Go to the main OPD registration counters or the patient help desk at Gate 2.
2. **Provide Identification:** Present the mobile number you used during registration, along with a valid government ID (such as your Aadhaar card). The staff can look up your patient records in the hospital database using your phone number or demographic details.
3. **Check Digital Portals:** If you booked your appointment online via the **ORS (Online Registration System)** portal (ors.gov.in) or an integrated health app, log into your account to view your appointment history and download your slip again.

For assistance, you can contact the PRO Office at **9415007710** or call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880**.

entries.question: Cancer and piliya ka ilaj hota hai kya
entries.answer:
Yes, both cancer and jaundice (piliya) treatment are available at KGMU. 

KGMU has dedicated departments and specialized facilities for these conditions:

- **Cancer (Oncology):** Specialized departments such as [Medical Oncology](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=59&dept_type=2), [Surgical Oncology](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=33&dept_type=2), and [Radiotherapy](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=29&dept_type=2) provide comprehensive cancer care, chemotherapy, radiation therapy, and surgical treatments.
- **Jaundice (Piliya / Liver & Gastrointestinal Issues):** Jaundice can be a symptom of various liver, gall bladder, or pancreatic conditions. Treatment is available through departments like [Medical Gastroenterology](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=49&dept_type=2), [Surgical Gastroenterology](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=32&dept_type=2), and [Internal Medicine](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=16&dept_type=2).

To consult a doctor, please book an OPD appointment online via [ORS](https://ors.gov.in) or through the other registration methods. 

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Mai apna RCT apointment kaise book kru
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for a Root Canal Treatment (RCT) at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods for the Dental OPD:

1. **Online via ORS:** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose King George's Medical University (KGMU), select the appropriate dental department for your issue, and book an appointment for ₹50.
2. **Via Mobile App:** Use the ABHA or Health Care mobile app to register and book your slot.
3. **Via SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital registration counter with your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to obtain a physical token and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee. Pre-booking is strongly recommended, and the registration counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.

For more details on courses and admissions, you can check the [KGMU Admissions page](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

entries.question: ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD के लिए ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं:

1. **ORS पोर्टल (Online Registration System):** [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं, राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और KGMU चुनें, नया अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करके पर्ची डाउनलोड करें।
2. **आयुष्मान भारत डिजिटल हेल्थ ऐप:** मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के माध्यम से रजिस्टर करके इसी प्रक्रिया का पालन करें।
3. **SMS द्वारा:** `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` लिखकर 8887019134 पर भेजें।
4. **वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):** अपना आधार कार्ड और एक्टिव मोबाइल नंबर लेकर आएं, काउंटर पर OTP और ₹50 शुल्क देकर OPD पर्ची प्राप्त करें।

**महत्वपूर्ण बातें:**
- OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 AM से दोपहर 1:00 PM) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 AM से दोपहर 12:00 PM)। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
- पर्ची काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है।
- बाहर के मरीजों को संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) लाना अनिवार्य है।
